selection_rule: Include each task instance with at least one published Holo4 trajectory marked successful in the source index and containing more than 10 effective business calls. Both criteria must hold for the same trajectory.
effective_call_definition: Successful api_fetch calls, minus identical GET/HEAD requests with identical results between writes; tool discovery, failures and unclassified results are excluded. Computed using count_calls in automationbench/scripts/long_trace_screen.py.
evidence_rule: Record the qualifying successful trajectory with the most effective calls, using trace ID lexicographic order as the tiebreaker.
